speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I understand you are suffering from a chronic cough and recurrent bouts of bronchitis. To better understand your condition, have you had any recent high fever, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old woman. The patient has been experiencing an aggressive cough producing copious amounts of thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum for about 11 years, with exacerbations similar to the current presentation today. Reports that the cough is worse in the morning and has had multiple evaluations in the past due to recurrent bouts of bronchitis requiring antibiotics treatment. The patient is a non-smoker.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis

Given your 11-year history of copious, thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum and recurrent "bronchitis" exacerbations requiring antibiotics, I need to confirm the underlying lung structure. Can you tell me if you have ever had a chest CT scan or if you have had blood tests for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency?
